relationships.subject: SRPK1
relationships.evidence_quote: Pharmacologic blockade of SRPK1 inhibits the SRSF1 and blocks neuropathic pain caused by nerve injury.

relationships.subject: CPEB
relationships.evidence_quote: Some progress has been made in defining downstream targets of CPEBs. One is calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase type IIα (CaMKIIα).

relationships.subject: FUS
relationships.evidence_quote: This appeared to drive nuclear factor κB signalling.

key_findings: Review of RNA-binding proteins in pain covering m6A (METTL3), splicing (SRSF1/VEGF-A), translation (eIF4E, eIF2α, CPEB, PABP, FMRP) and decay.
METTL3 effects on nociception are conflicting between reports.
